conclusions: All 66 current requirement results remain NOT_RUN. No in-flight or historical result is promoted.

SOURCE_ONLY_WINDOWS is a scope/environment/limitations label, not an additional acceptance status. The matrix allows only PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN/NOT_APPLICABLE. Keep aggregate mandatory-platform status separate from a bounded Windows result.

Every draft row currently has exactly one mapped_source_cases anchor. Passing that anchor is not sufficient where the requirement has additional clauses. Expand exact executed case inventories from assertion bodies and join actual current execution instances before scoped acceptance.

The 31 SOURCE_SUPPORTED rows are candidate source-evidence routes, not 31 currently complete mappings. Some also have useful native assertions; native fixture success cannot replace unmapped semantic clauses.

E2E-03 can gain a SOURCE_ONLY_WINDOWS result from the actual complete exact-clean source execution independently of native success. API and core clock/security negatives can also have bounded source subresults; this does not remove the draft's packaged product demonstration gates.

The draft still names f86ee89/fec8af0 and several old pending implementation statements. Root must replace stale subject/implementation/profile-state statements with verified current facts; historical hashes remain historical.

All seven native groups / all 130 PQR commands passing would not itself establish every matrix requirement, required OS, real commissioning item, complete legacy applicability decision or independent audit.
